name: Dylan Corbett-Bader
bio: Dylan Corbett-Bader is known for A Haunting in Venice (2023), Andor (2022) and The Tattooist of Auschwitz (2024).

credits.title: Mersea
credits.overview: Sonny never planned to come back home. But when his mother dies, he heads back into town under cover of night, hoping to say goodbye without stirring up trouble.

credits.title: Badger
credits.overview: One afternoon whilst on a mission to save an injured Badger, Ella meets Josh. During their meeting, everything hangs in the balance as Ella learns how it feels to become the prey.

credits.title: A Haunting in Venice
credits.overview: Celebrated sleuth Hercule Poirot, now retired and living in self-imposed exile in Venice, reluctantly attends a Halloween séance at a decaying, haunted palazzo. When one of the guests is murdered, the detective is thrust into a sinister world of shadows and secrets.

credits.overview: A meditation on addiction and grief
